### 2026-10-05 – October 5th: Intro

**2h**

October 5th: Intro
First day of working on the Half Life!!!

Started my session by going through all the tutorials and did all the preferences and stuff like that. Read through journal examples. Then go to the project choosing part. I first thought of choosing my own project first, so I went in the internet to search for a project idea to inspire me. I was searching for something like a desktop pet and then realized Starbie was the thing I wanted to do. 15 minute down the drain great.

Read through the github page of Starbie tutorial

### 2026-10-07 – October 7th: MAJOR BREAKTHROUGH

**3h**

October 7th: MAJOR BREAKTHROUGH

Today, I was very optimistic work after the long PSAT.  I don't think I mentioned it in my idea reel and my initial post, but I wanted to change the shape of starbie and make it my own. My first idea was an animal like a dog, but that didn't feel like me. So, I chose it to be a slime. A slime from the 2D platformer games we all played. Apparently, KiCAD doesn't have spline to trace over my reference photo. So, I opened up fusion.

![Screenshot 2026-10-07 220825](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/596d395875c58f8a72728adcd660aeb793b22eec58708913162a92d165ec1998.png)
(bruh, im not waiting for this...)

So I opened my trusty browser Onshape and got started. But when I was done with it, I didn't like it. It felt simple and boring. Then this came.

![Screenshot 2026-10-07 221343](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/5b65647027eff8106f2c427e99f0a7faf6fdcb4a42344f4e5ba2374f5d42cd5c.png)

DITTO!!!!! What an amazing underappreciated Pokemon. Took some time with the splines and made it perfect to my abilities. Then, I imported this to my KiCAD and set it as the boundary.

![Screenshot 2026-10-07 224033](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/7115e8e57a541fc46195547bd24068f0746231d7d0b4c8abb2343f0ca7d5a079.png)

I wanted to feel like I was interacting with ditto so I put both the keycaps on its "hand". Also, I wanted the eyes and mouth to be filled in, and apparently I could use Silkscreen, so I did that. Hopefully that isn't the issue.

I have no clue how this took 3 hours so not my most productive day. But, now I feel like I'm doing my own project!!!
